headline: 靈魂搖滾天團完美回歸
context: 美國靈魂搖滾樂團 Alabama Shakes 2017年解散、沉寂七年，2024年12月幾乎沒有預警就重新登台。主唱 Brittany Howard 說，這次回歸源自一場替朋友釀酒廠辦的募款演出，之後決定正式復出，新專輯內容直指當下美國的政治現況。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The soul-rockers achieved worldwide success before surprising everyone by deciding to quit while they were ahead. Now they’re back with a new album railing against the state of contemporary America In the autumn of 2024, Alabama Shakes showed no sign of ending their indefinite hiatus – and nobody was asking them to. Seven years had passed since the blues-soul-rock band, who exploded out of Athens, Alabama in 2009, had last shared a stage. Their transatlantic Top 10 2012 debut Boys & Girls announced them; the million-selling 2015 follow-up Sound & Color went to No 1 in the US and won them four Grammys. Their fanbase included Bruce Springsteen, Robert Plant and Barack Obama. But by 2017 they were physically and creatively spent, and they stopped. Then, in December 2024, with almost no warning, they played their first show in more than seven years. “We had a friend in Tuscaloosa who had a brewery, but it wasn’t doing so well after Covid,” explains singer Brittany Howard. “He called me and said he was going to do a fundraiser and asked if I’d like to perform. I said, ‘For sure.’” But then she started reminiscing, remembering how that particular friend had been a huge help to the band, not just her personally. She felt the band owed him something, collectively. “So I called the fellas,” she smiles. “‘Do y’all wanna perform at this thing – like, all of us, together?’ And they instantly said yes.” Continue reading...
sources.title: ‘We were in danger of running it into the ground’: Brittany Howard on fleeing fame, fighting Trump and the epic return of Alabama Shakes

thread_text:
美國靈魂搖滾樂團 Alabama Shakes 回來了，而且帶著新專輯。他們2009年在阿拉巴馬州雅典鎮起家，2012年的首張專輯《Boys & Girls》登上美英排行榜前十，2015年的《Sound & Color》賣破百萬、拿下四項葛萊美，還讓 Bruce Springsteen、Robert Plant 和歐巴馬都成了粉絲。可是2017年，樂團身心俱疲，直接停下來。2024年12月，他們幾乎沒有預警就重新登台——起因是主唱 Brittany Howard 想幫一位在圖斯卡盧薩開釀酒廠的朋友辦募款演出。這一唱，就決定正式回歸，新專輯的內容直接對準當下美國的政治現況。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026年7月19日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
美國靈魂搖滾樂團 Alabama Shakes 帶著新專輯回歸了。這支樂團2009年在阿拉巴馬州雅典鎮成軍，2012年首張專輯《Boys & Girls》打入美英排行榜前十，2015年《Sound & Color》銷量破百萬，拿下四項葛萊美獎，歌迷名單裡甚至有 Bruce Springsteen、Robert Plant 和歐巴馬。2017年，樂團身心俱疲，直接休止。2024年12月，主唱 Brittany Howard 為了幫一位在圖斯卡盧薩開釀酒廠、疫情後生意不好的朋友辦募款演出，找回全員一起登台——沒想到這一場，讓他們決定正式復出。新專輯的內容，直接對準了當下美國的政治現況。

本則來自 The Guardian，2026年7月19日發佈。
voice_text: 美國靈魂搖滾樂團 Alabama Shakes 回來了，帶著新專輯復出。這支樂團2009年在阿拉巴馬州起家，2012年首張專輯打進美英排行榜前十，2015年那張賣破百萬、拿下四項葛萊美，歌迷裡還有搖滾巨星和前總統歐巴馬。2017年，他們身心俱疲，直接停下來。轉機出現在2024年底——主唱 Brittany Howard 為了幫一位朋友辦募款演出，找全員一起登台，結果一唱就決定正式回歸。新專輯的內容，直接對準了現在美國的政治局勢。
